one_line: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops benchmarks, while US and China tighten AI policies and industry sees big deals.

themes.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon
themes.text: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model that achieved top rankings on AI Index and leading cybersecurity benchmarks, though it is not yet publicly released.

stories.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on AI Index and leads cybersecurity benchmarks

themes.title: AI policy actions in US and China
themes.text: OpenAI set up an election‑war room to monitor misinformation ahead of the U.S. midterms, New York enacted a law restricting unsafe AI chatbot features for minors, and China proposed export controls on 23 AI technologies.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of US midterms
New York governor signs law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors
China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies

themes.title: Industry investments and AI partnerships
themes.text: Upwind Security raised $400 million in Series C funding, Sarvam AI signed a five‑year MoU with India’s defence ministry to develop AI applications, and Freshworks acquired Israeli startup Robusta Dev to add incident‑investigation AI to its platform.

stories.headline: Upwind Security raises $400 million Series C at $3.8 billion valuation
Sarvam AI signs five‑year MoU with Indian defence to develop AI applications
Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to add incident‑investigation AI to Freshservice
